content.short: Enzyme Finance is an easy-to-use DeFi asset management system.
content.description: Enzyme is a user-friendly DeFi asset management system that funds, investment clubs, DAO treasuries, and companies can plug into. For users, it simplifies interaction with DeFi by acting as an aggregator of protocols and making asset management seamless. It also serves as a DeFi Operating System for developers, and its high customisability lets developers build almost anything in DeFi on top of its core platform, enabling diverse investment workflows across funds, clubs, treasuries, and startups.
content.meta: Enzyme Finance is a DeFi asset management protocol for creating and managing onchain vaults. Discover Enzyme Finance and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
